rules.name: grasa-barrier-vol-cfs
rules.sql: WITH pairs(client, product) AS (VALUES ('ACM','CM CRD'), ('ACM','CM CT'), ('AMC','CM CT'), ('ASI','CM CT'), ('ASI','CM DF'), ('BFA','CM CT'), ('BOV','CM C'), ('CPB','CM CT'), ('FMP','CM CT'), ('HSD','CM C'), ('IOL','CM BO'), ('IOL','CM RS'), ('LIB','CM CT'), ('MAO','CM W'), ('ORM','CM C'), ('SIP','CM OR EUR')), vd AS (SELECT value_date FROM opera.valuation_date_table WHERE upper(business_unit) = :bu LIMIT 1), sec AS ( SELECT DISTINCT p.client, p.product, c.security_id FROM opera.helper_sensitivity_report_view_cache_table c JOIN pairs p ON upper(substring(c.contract_number, 1, 3)) = upper(p.client) AND upper(trim(c.product_code)) = upper(trim(p.product)) WHERE upper(trim(c.business_unit)) = :bu), leg AS ( SELECT s.client, s.product, m.security_id, m.derivative_type, m.strike1, m.vol1_id, CASE WHEN lower(m.derivative_type) LIKE '%call%' THEN 'C' ELSE 'P' END AS side, (SELECT upper(cpm.call_put_id) FROM opera.derivative_type_call_put_id_mapping_table cpm WHERE upper(cpm.derivative_type) = upper(m.derivative_type) LIMIT 1) AS mapped_side FROM sec s JOIN opera.cloned_security_info_table m ON m.security_id = s.security_id AND upper(m.business_unit) = :bu WHERE m.status = 'Active' AND lower(m.derivative_type) LIKE 'amer%' AND m.maturity_date > (SELECT value_date FROM vd)), vids AS (SELECT DISTINCT vol1_id FROM leg WHERE vol1_id IS NOT NULL), side_cnt AS ( -- one pass over the day's surface for the vol ids in play SELECT sv.vol_id, upper(sv.call_put_id) AS cp, COUNT(*) AS n FROM opera.settlement_vol_surf_table sv WHERE sv.value_date = (SELECT value_date FROM vd) AND sv.vol_id IN (SELECT vol1_id FROM vids) GROUP BY sv.vol_id, upper(sv.call_put_id)), strikes AS ( SELECT DISTINCT sv.vol_id, upper(sv.call_put_id) AS cp, sv.strike FROM opera.settlement_vol_surf_table sv WHERE sv.value_date = (SELECT value_date FROM vd) AND sv.vol_id IN (SELECT vol1_id FROM vids)), ov AS ( SELECT DISTINCT cv.security_id FROM opera.calculated_settle_vol_table cv WHERE upper(cv.business_unit) = :bu AND cv.p1_vol > 0 AND cv.security_id IN (SELECT security_id FROM leg)), chk AS ( SELECT l.*, COALESCE((SELECT n FROM side_cnt sc WHERE sc.vol_id = l.vol1_id AND sc.cp = l.side), 0) AS side_rows, EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM strikes k WHERE k.vol_id = l.vol1_id AND k.cp = l.mapped_side AND k.strike = l.strike1) AS exact_hit, EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ov WHERE ov.security_id = l.security_id) AS overlay FROM leg l) SELECT client, product, derivative_type, COUNT(*) AS legs, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE strike1 IS NULL) AS strike1_null, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE mapped_side IS NULL) AS no_cp_mapping, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE vol1_id IS NULL) AS vol1_null, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE side_rows = 0) AS no_rows_on_side, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE exact_hit) AS exact_strike_hit, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE overlay) AS has_overlay, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT exact_hit AND NOT overlay AND (strike1 IS NULL OR vol1_id IS NULL OR side_rows = 0)) AS no_usable_vol, MIN(security_id) FILTER (WHERE NOT exact_hit AND NOT overlay AND (strike1 IS NULL OR vol1_id IS NULL OR side_rows = 0)) AS sample_bad_security FROM chk GROUP BY client, product, derivative_type ORDER BY no_usable_vol DESC, client, product, derivative_type
